name: 2PAC Fighter Restoration Mod
description: 2PAC as a fighter, with bespoke animations, voice lines, model, and textures. Three selectable outfits in-game: Shirtless, Red Wings, and Birdie. Includes custom UI artwork and 27 combat recordings mapped across 81 voice slots.
